reuse.why: The new link handler goes through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, and the balance computation reuses Akahu's branch; the download function is a copy rather than a shared helper.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadPluggyAiTransactions (token, post, error mapping, response reshaping), adding one more copy of the per-provider download pattern.

placement.why: Each piece sits where its siblings live (handler in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models).

scope.why: Only Fintegra support, its type and a release note.

maintainability.why: The provider is added to the local syncSource literal union of linkBankSyncAccount but not to the central SYNC_PROVIDERS list that defines AccountSyncSource, so the set of providers is now inconsistent across the tree, and the download copy must be kept in step with the others.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Linking uses the shared linkBankSyncAccount and assertBankAccountNotLinked; the copied download follows the tree's existing per-provider pattern (no shared download helper exists).

disguised_duplication.where: The download function is an overt copy of the Pluggy.ai one.
